Routines

top source red::pinholecalib2

SST pipeline

red::pinholecalib2, avg_fpistates=avg_fpistates, cams=cams, dir=dir, manual=manual, margin=margin, overwrite=overwrite, pref=pref, refcam=refcam, threshold=threshold, verbose=verbose, verify=verify, warp_dim=warp_dim

Compute the (forward and backward) warping matrices to map the camera images to a common reference, which is defined by fitting a regular grid to the selected 'reference'.
